data.narrative:
CarbonCure Technologies is a Series F climate and energy company founded by Robert Niven that has raised $169M to date. The valuation peer set in Climate & Energy comprises 1 public company and 8 private firms, including Helion, Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, and Electric Hydrogen. However, a narrow peer-median approach proved inapplicable due to insufficient same-stage and adjacent-stage comparables—only 1 same-stage peer was identified across the sector, below the minimum threshold of 3 datapoints needed for statistical reliability.

Given data constraints, stage-progression methodology was the primary applicable approach. Using total capital raised of $169M as a valuation proxy and applying a typical Series F-to-next-stage step-up multiplier of 1.3x yields an implied valuation of $220M. This single-method triangulation supports a median estimate of $220M, with a range anchored at $187M (low) and $253M (high) to reflect inherent uncertainty.

The narrow peer set and reliance on a single valuation method present material limitations. A more robust analysis would require either identification of additional comparable-stage Climate & Energy exits or deployment of fundamental methods tied to revenue multiples or cash-flow assumptions—neither of which were provided in the available data. Key uncertainties center on CarbonCure's revenue trajectory, unit economics within carbon utilization, and relative positioning versus better-capitalized peers in the sector.
